title: Untangle d/gtkmm4 deterministic dependency stack
description:
Scope:

Resolve the real build/dependency problem behind d/gtkmm4 so the package can be rebuilt and validated without Meson VCS fallbacks.

Current understanding:
- d/gtkmm4 now correctly disables Meson fallback wraps with --wrap-mode=nofallback.
- gtkmm-4.6.1 requires gtk4 >= 4.6.0, but the current tracked host baseline is gtk4 4.4.1.
- The historical gtkmm4-4.6.1-x86_64-2slint package payload bundled cairomm-1.16 and pangomm-2.48 outputs.
- The upstream gtkmm 4.6.1 wrap files point at live git branches, so reproducing the historical payload via default Meson fallbacks is not acceptable for distro packaging.

Acceptance criteria:
- Decide and document the intended package model for gtkmm4: either keep the bundled cairomm/pangomm payload using fixed, reviewable source inputs, or rebaseline gtkmm4 onto separately packaged dependencies.
- Land the necessary packaging changes for the chosen model without using VCS/network fallbacks inside build().
- Record which dependency floor must be present in the target Slint environment before slackbuilds-ihxn can close.
- Leave slackbuilds-ihxn with a concrete next validation path.
notes: 2026-03-29: Claimed for the split work. Plan is to split the bundled cairomm/pangomm payload out of gtkmm4 into standalone versioned packages, then rewire gtkmm4 to depend on them and keep Meson fallback disabled.
close_reason: Split stack landed via standalone l/cairomm16 and l/pangomm48 package definitions, d/gtkmm4 now keeps Meson fallback disabled, and the remaining validation/base-floor work is tracked in slackbuilds-dmfk and slackbuilds-wnjb.

title: Validate gtk3 alias cleanup: rebuild affected packages
description: Rebuild packages whose tracked dependency metadata used the gtk3 alias, verify generated dependency closure resolves gtk+3, and confirm gnote is no longer blocked via gspell.
notes:
Affected rebuild set for gtk3 alias cleanup: 1) l/gspell, 2) xap/webkit2gtk, 3) ap/ulauncher, 4) xap/fontforge, 5) ap/cerebro, 6) ap/gnome-dictionary, 7) ap/grub-customizer, 8) ap/hardinfo, 9) ap/hardinfo2, 10) ap/lightdm-slick-greeter, 11) ap/metacity, 12) ap/mousetweaks, 13) ap/obconf, 14) ap/plank, 15) ap/zeitgeist. Indirect retest: ap/gnote. Additional fix landed during validation: l/gspell no longer requires nonexistent gtk-doc and ap/gnote no longer inherits gtk-doc in dependency closure. Evidence so far: bash -n passed for touched SLKBUILDs; shellcheck -s bash build-package.sh passed; build-package.sh --dependencies resolves gtk+3 for l/gspell, ap/gnote, and xap/webkit2gtk, and no longer lists gtk-doc for l/gspell or ap/gnote. Residual unrelated risk: xap/webkit2gtk listing still warns about duplicate atk providers.
2026-04-04 audit: validator pass over the affected rebuild set found 14/16 packages passing. Two blockers remain. 1) ap/mousetweaks resolves gtk+3 but is missing build evidence entirely: no build log, package artifact, or md5 is present; validate_pkg.sh fails with 'Missing package artifact (*.txz)'. 2) ap/lightdm-slick-greeter current artifact is invalid: validate_pkg.sh reports a hard failure from the build log ('No package 'xapp' found' and a failed move of slick-greeter.desktop), and the built txz only contains config/doc payload. ap/lightdm-slick-greeter/SLKBUILD has been patched locally to fail fast on autogen/configure/make/install/rename and now passes bash -n and shellcheck. Root-cause follow-up is tracked separately once created.
Follow-up bug for the lightdm-slick-greeter blocker: slackbuilds-mex1 (Fix xapp pkg-config metadata to unblock lightdm-slick-greeter).
2026-04-06 rebuild validation rerun after the latest user rebuilds: validate_pkg.sh now passes for l/gspell, xap/webkit2gtk, ap/ulauncher, xap/fontforge, ap/cerebro, ap/gnome-dictionary, ap/grub-customizer, ap/hardinfo, ap/hardinfo2, ap/metacity, ap/mousetweaks, ap/obconf, ap/plank, ap/zeitgeist, and indirect retest ap/gnote. ap/lightdm-slick-greeter remains the sole failing package in the 781z set: both build-lightdm-slick-greeter-2.0.3-x86_64-2slint.log and build-lightdm-slick-greeter.log fail at configure with No package 'xapp' found, and no .txz/.md5/.dep was produced. Generated depfiles for the rebuilt packages now contain gtk+3 and no gtk3 alias. Resolver checks on 2026-04-06: ./build-package.sh --dependencies l/gspell, xap/webkit2gtk, and ap/gnote all resolve gtk+3; xap/webkit2gtk still emits the pre-existing duplicate atk-provider warning. Syntax check: bash -n passes for ap/lightdm-slick-greeter/SLKBUILD, ap/xapp/SLKBUILD, and build-package.sh. ShellCheck still reports SC2206, SC2155, and SC2086 warnings in ap/xapp/SLKBUILD, so the xapp follow-up remains open under slackbuilds-mex1.
2026-04-24 final validation: slackbuilds-mex1 is closed after fixing xapp packaging. ap/lightdm-slick-greeter now passes bash -n and shellcheck, build-package.sh --dependencies lists xapp, build-package.sh -n --only ap/lightdm-slick-greeter succeeds, the generated package-style depfile contains xapp, validate_pkg.sh ap/lightdm-slick-greeter PASS, and the package payload contains usr/bin/slick-greeter plus usr/share/xgreeters/lightdm-slick-greeter.desktop. This resolves the sole remaining package failure from the 2026-04-06 gtk3 alias validation rerun. The prior duplicate atk-provider warning for xap/webkit2gtk remains documented as unrelated.
close_reason: Completed: all affected gtk3 alias cleanup rebuild checks are accounted for. The 2026-04-06 rerun had only ap/lightdm-slick-greeter failing, and the 2026-04-24 xapp fix now lets it build and validate with depfile xapp coverage and payload smoke checks.

- l/libcacard: fakeroot slkbuild -X built libcacard-2.8.1-x86_64-1slint.txz with matching build log/md5; validate_pkg.sh --require-baseline PASS.

- l/judy: after removing the extra legacy doc copy, the only remaining validator delta versus the fetched baseline is usr/lib64/libJudy.a. That static archive is intentional for this package lineage: the legacy SlackBuild at ap/spkg/judy/judy.SlackBuild sets BUILD=${BUILD:-1slintstatic} and packages the static library as part of the artifact. The fetched repo baseline (judy-1.0.5-x86_64-4.txz) is therefore the wrong comparison target for this converted static package, while the local build/log/payload checks still pass.

2026-03-29 hardening follow-up.

- Updated d/gtkmm4/SLKBUILD to pass --wrap-mode=nofallback to meson setup so distro builds do not silently fetch moving git subprojects from the release tarball's wrap files.
- Re-ran bash -n d/gtkmm4/SLKBUILD: PASS.
- Re-ran shellcheck d/gtkmm4/SLKBUILD: PASS.

- fakeroot slkbuild -X still did not produce a package artifact, but the failure is now deterministic and expected: Meson stops at meson.build:106 with "Dependency 'gtk4' is required but not found" after reporting host gtk4 4.4.1 < required 4.6.0 and explicitly "Use of fallback dependencies is disabled."
- This confirms the previous wayland-client >= 1.24.0 failure was coming from unpinned upstream fallback behavior, not from the intended package dependency graph.
- Because no artifact was built, baseline manifest comparison and package smoketests still could not run.

2026-03-29 deeper dependency audit.

- Upstream gtkmm-4.6.1/meson.build requires gtk4 >= 4.6.0, giomm-2.68 >= 2.68.0, cairomm-1.16 >= 1.15.4, and pangomm-2.48 >= 2.50.0.
- Official GTK 4.6.x release tarballs require wayland-client >= 1.20.0 and wayland-protocols >= 1.23, so the earlier wayland-client >= 1.24.0 stop was only from gtkmm's accidental fallback to gtk.git main, not from the GTK 4.6 release line.
- Host pkg-config state confirms the immediate local blocker is gtk4 only: gtk4 reports 4.4.1, while giomm-2.68 reports 2.70.0, cairomm-1.16 reports 1.16.1, and pangomm-2.48 reports 2.50.0.
- /var/log/packages shows gtkmm4-4.6.1-x86_64-2slint itself owns usr/lib64/pkgconfig/cairomm-1.16.pc and usr/lib64/pkgconfig/pangomm-2.48.pc plus the matching headers and shared libraries, so the historical gtkmm4 package payload bundled cairomm and pangomm outputs instead of relying on separate tracked packages.
- The gtkmm-4.6.1 tarball's Meson wrap files point at live git branches for gtk (main), pangomm (master), glibmm (master), and cairomm (master). Keeping --wrap-mode=nofallback in d/gtkmm4 is therefore required for deterministic distro packaging.
- Follow-up work is needed to decide whether gtkmm4 should keep shipping the bundled cairomm/pangomm payload via fixed source inputs or be rebaselined onto separately packaged dependencies before this validation can close.

2026-03-29 split-stack follow-up from slackbuilds-0w5f.

- Landed standalone l/cairomm16 and l/pangomm48 package definitions so gtkmm4 no longer needs to keep owning those ABI lines.
- Local build evidence after the split: cairomm16 builds successfully; pangomm48 now fails deterministically with Meson fallback disabled because host pangocairo/pango is 1.48.11 and needs >= 1.49.4; gtkmm4 still fails deterministically because host gtk4 is 4.4.1 and needs >= 4.6.0.
- This means the remaining gtkmm4 validation blocker is no longer wayland or fallback behavior. It is the base stack floor: pango first for pangomm48, then gtk4 for gtkmm4.
